name: BRIJ x402 Directory
purpose: A small public directory of x402 APIs that an AI assistant can discover, inspect, and call through a connected BRIJ wallet.
important: This directory is only for discovery. It does not execute requests and does not hold secrets.
Use each provider's openapi_url to understand paths, methods, parameters, and request bodies.
When ready to call a paid endpoint, use the BRIJ MCP tool named brij_pay.
Do not ask the user for wallet keys, payment headers, or private keys. BRIJ handles payment.

recommended_flow: Pick a provider whose use_when field matches the user's task.
Open openapi_url to inspect available endpoints.
Build the target x402 URL from x402_base_url plus the OpenAPI path.
Before calling brij_pay, inspect the OpenAPI operation and include every required query parameter, path parameter, header, and request body field.
Call brij_pay with url, method, headers, and optional body.
Return the provider response to the user.
If payment fails, report the exact BRIJ or provider error.

arguments.url: Full paid x402 URL to call.
arguments.body: Optional request body. For JSON payloads, pass a JSON string.

providers.name: AgentMail x402 API
providers.description: Email inbox and messaging API for creating inboxes, listing messages, sending email, replying, and fetching attachments.
providers.use_when: Use when the user wants an AI assistant to work with email inboxes or messages.

providers.name: FOV Email Finder and Verifier
providers.description: Email finder and verifier API for finding professional email addresses, verifying email deliverability, and searching emails by domain.
providers.use_when: Use when the user wants to find or verify an email address, enrich a lead, or discover emails for a company domain.

providers.name: BRIJ Flight API
providers.description: Flight API for paid flight search, escrow-backed booking intents, booking execution, refund requests, and Duffel order status lookup.
providers.use_when: Use when the user wants to search flights, create a booking intent, book a flight, request a refund, or check flight order status.

providers.name: Messari News API
providers.use_when: Use when the user asks for crypto news, market headlines, or recent ecosystem updates.

providers.name: Nansen Wallet Intel API
providers.use_when: Use when the user asks to analyze wallets, token balances, related wallets, or token intelligence.

providers.name: QuickNode Solana Mainnet RPC API
providers.use_when: Use when the user asks for Solana chain data such as slots, block height, balances, transactions, or RPC methods.
